summary: Moderate. You can build a HubSpot OAuth app self-serve on the developer platform, usually through the HubSpot CLI. Install caps are what slow you down: a privately distributed app reaches 10 customer accounts, and a marketplace-distribution app reaches 25 until its Marketplace listing is approved. Listing needs 3 active installs and a review of up to about 60 days.

oauth_support_claim.text: HubSpot apps that are distributed to multiple accounts must use OAuth.
oauth_support_claim.quote: your app must use OAuth as its sole authorization method
oauth_support_claim.note: This is a Marketplace listing requirement.

difficulty_claim.text: Creating the app is self-serve. Scaling past 10 (private) or 25 (marketplace distribution) customer accounts requires Marketplace listing approval.
difficulty_claim.quote: apps that are created or migrated to version 2025.2 are capped at 25 installs until they are listed on the HubSpot Marketplace

claim.text: Composio publishes a HubSpot OAuth setup guide for bringing your own app. This pass did not confirm whether a Composio-managed HubSpot app exists.
claim.note: Set COMPOSIO_API_KEY and regenerate to check the live catalog.

endpoints.note: Long-standing HubSpot endpoints, not re-checked in this pass. Confirm them against the OAuth docs link.

hands_on.text: 1-2 hours (developer account, CLI install, project, redirect URLs)
hands_on.note: The CLI path needs Node.js 20+ and a personal access key.

approval_wait.text: None for up to 10 private / 25 marketplace-distribution installs. Listing: initial review within 10 business days, whole process up to about 60 days after feedback.
approval_wait.quote: The entire app review and feedback process should take no more than 60 days from the time feedback is shared.

fastest_path.text: Start with private distribution (up to 10 customer accounts, 100 for Solutions Partners). You can switch to marketplace distribution later without breaking installs.
fastest_path.quote: You can also start with a private distribution project-based app and switch it to marketplace distribution later without interrupting existing installs

steps.title: Create a HubSpot developer account
steps.detail: Use a developer account, not your production CRM portal, and create a test account for installs.

steps.title: Install the HubSpot CLI and authenticate
steps.detail: npm install -g @hubspot/cli, then hs account auth with a personal access key.
steps.why_human: Generating the personal access key needs your HubSpot login.
steps.note: From a third-party (Microsoft Databricks) setup guide that reflects the current HubSpot platform.

steps.title: Create an OAuth project app
steps.detail: hs project create --project-base app --auth oauth --distribution private (or marketplace). Set auth.redirectUrls in app-hsmeta.json to your Composio callback, then upload the project.
steps.note: An agent can generate the project config. A person runs the upload with their own credentials.

steps.title: Sign the Acceptable Use Policy
steps.detail: Developers report installs failing with 'the app developer has not signed the acceptable use policy' until it is signed.
steps.note: Community forum report, not official docs.

steps.title: Allowlist or install into customer accounts
steps.detail: Private distribution: up to 10 customer accounts (100 for Solutions Partners). Marketplace distribution: up to 25 installs before listing.
steps.quote: app partners can distribute apps privately via OAuth to up to 10 customers or 100 for Solution Partners

phases.name: Marketplace listing (to scale past the caps)

steps.title: Reach 3 active installs from unaffiliated accounts
steps.detail: 'Active' means successful OAuth API calls or webhook activity in the past 30 days, from production accounts outside your organization.
steps.quote: your app must have at least three active, unique installs

steps.title: Prepare the listing: setup docs, demo video, pricing, shared-data table
steps.detail: All URLs must be live and crawlable. The pricing must match your website, and the shared-data table must match your scopes.
steps.quote: All URLs in your HubSpot Marketplace listing must lead to live, publicly available, and functional pages.
steps.note: An agent can draft the setup docs and shared-data table.

steps.title: Agree to the Technology Partner Program Agreement and submit
steps.detail: HubSpot's Ecosystem Quality team reviews the listing manually.

requirements.title: OAuth only, single app ID
requirements.detail: A listed app must authorize with the public app ID tied to its listing and use OAuth as its sole method.

requirements.title: AI connectors need user-level permissions
requirements.detail: An app that mainly connects HubSpot to generative AI tools must use user-level access or HubSpot's MCP server.
requirements.quote: if your app is an AI connector
requirements.note: This applies directly to agent builders.

gotchas.title: Legacy apps over 25 installs get capped on migration
gotchas.detail: Migrating an older public app to the 2025.2 platform enforces the cap automatically.
gotchas.quote: the install limit will be automatically enforced

gotchas.title: Unused scopes get rejected
gotchas.detail: Remove scopes you do not use, or mark them conditionally required or optional.
gotchas.quote: Scopes that are not used must be removed.

gotchas.title: Allowlist the HubSpot crawler
gotchas.detail: HubSpot crawls your listing URLs during review. Blocking its crawler delays review.

blockers.title: Install cap before listing
blockers.detail: Your 11th private customer, or 26th marketplace-distribution install, is blocked until you are listed.
blockers.workaround: Start the listing once you have 3 active external installs. Solutions Partners get 100 private installs.

agent_can: Generate the HubSpot project and app-hsmeta.json with redirect URLs and minimal scopes
Draft setup documentation, the shared-data table and the listing copy
Track active-install counts against the 3-install and 25-install thresholds
human_must: Create the developer account and personal access key
Sign the Acceptable Use Policy and the Technology Partner Program Agreement
Recruit 3 unaffiliated active installs and record the demo video

conflicts.topic: Can you still create an app in the web UI?
conflicts.positions: A Microsoft Databricks guide says HubSpot retired the legacy public app creation UI. Other third-party connector docs still describe a legacy web-interface path.
conflicts.resolution: Use the CLI project path, which HubSpot documents as current.

unknowns: Whether Composio offers a managed HubSpot OAuth app.
HubSpot authorize/token endpoints were not re-checked live in this pass.

audit.claim: HubSpot is moderate: self-serve, marketplace listing needs review
audit.method: Fetched HubSpot's listing requirements and install-limit changelog on 2026-10-28.
audit.note: Added the install caps (10 private / 25 marketplace) as the real limit, not the listing itself.
'Active' was tightened: unaffiliated production accounts with activity in the past 30 days.

audit.method: HubSpot CLI docs plus a Databricks guide.
audit.note: The current platform is CLI and project based. Whether the legacy UI is fully retired is a conflict between third-party sources.
